title_en: Guiding Case No. 244: Hu v. Putian Intermediate People's Court of Fujian Province — criminal compensation for infringement of personal freedom after retrial of innocence
ruling_gist_en: Where the main criminal facts found in the original judgment are determined to be unfounded by the retrial judgment, resulting in the actual term of imprisonment served by the compensation claimant exceeding the term determined in the retrial judgment, the provisions of Article 6 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Handling of Criminal Compensation Cases may be applied by reference. That article provides that 'in cases where multiple crimes are combined for punishment and some charges are found not established upon retrial, and the period of imprisonment exceeds the term determined in the retrial judgment, if a citizen applies for state compensation for the excessive imprisonment, compensation shall be granted.' Accordingly, compensation shall be granted for the excessive imprisonment.

full_text_en:
Guiding Case No. 244: Hu v. Putian Intermediate People's Court of Fujian Province — criminal compensation for wrongful imprisonment

(Discussed and adopted by the Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court, released on December 23, 2024)

Keywords: state compensation; criminal compensation for damage to personal freedom; joinder of punishment for multiple crimes; partial criminal facts not established; commutation of sentence upon retrial; excessive imprisonment

Ruling Gist

Where the principal criminal facts found in the original judgment are determined by the retrial judgment to be unsustainable, resulting in the compensation claimant's actual term of imprisonment exceeding the sentence determined in the retrial judgment, reference may be made to the provisions of Article 6 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Compensation Cases, which states: "Where in a case involving joinder of punishment for multiple crimes, upon retrial, some charges are found to be unsustainable, and the period of imprisonment exceeds the sentence determined in the retrial judgment, if a citizen applies for state compensation for the excessive imprisonment, compensation shall be decided to be paid," and compensation shall be granted for the excessive imprisonment.

Basic Facts

Hu was criminally detained on October 5, 2012, on suspicion of fraud and robbery. On July 16, 2013, the Xiuyu District People's Court of Putian, Fujian Province, rendered criminal judgment (2013) Xiu Xing Chu Zi No. 160, finding Hu guilty of fraud and sentencing him to one year and nine months of fixed-term imprisonment and a fine of RMB 2,000 (all subsequent amounts are in RMB unless otherwise indicated); finding him guilty of robbery and sentencing him to 11 years and 6 months of fixed-term imprisonment and a fine of RMB 10,000; and deciding, upon joinder of punishment for multiple crimes, to execute a combined sentence of 12 years and 6 months of fixed-term imprisonment and a fine of RMB 12,000. After the judgment was pronounced, Hu refused to accept it and appealed. The Putian Intermediate People's Court of Fujian Province rendered a criminal ruling (2013) Pu Xing Zhong Zi No. 407 on November 16 of the same year, rejecting the appeal and affirming the original judgment.

After the judgment took effect, Hu filed a petition for retrial. The Putian Intermediate People's Court of Fujian Province rejected his petition. Hu then filed a petition for retrial with the Fujian High People's Court. The Fujian High People's Court rendered a retrial decision (2016) Min Xing Shen No. 121 on March 8, 2017, ordering the Putian Intermediate People's Court of Fujian Province to form a new collegial panel for retrial.

After retrial, the Putian Intermediate People's Court of Fujian Province held: The defendant Hu, with the intent of illegal possession, in collusion with others, used fabricated facts to defraud the victim Lin of RMB 7,500, which constituted a relatively large amount, and his conduct constituted the crime of fraud. The original trial and appellate judgments correctly found Hu guilty of fraud, but the findings that Hu participated in defrauding Zhu of RMB 23,000 and in robbing Chen of RMB 93,000 lacked factual basis. Accordingly, on October 15, 2018, it rendered criminal judgment (2017) Min 03 Xing Zai No. 1: 1. Revoking the Putian Intermediate People's Court's criminal ruling (2013) Pu Xing Zhong Zi No. 407 and the Xiuyu District People's Court's criminal judgment (2013) Xiu Xing Chu Zi No. 160; 2. Hu was guilty of fraud and sentenced to six months of fixed-term imprisonment (from October 5, 2012 to April 4, 2013) and a fine of RMB 1,000.

On October 15, 2018, Hu was released. Subsequently, Hu applied for state compensation to the Putian Intermediate People's Court of Fujian Province.

Judgment

On June 4, 2019, the Putian Intermediate People's Court of Fujian Province rendered state compensation decision (2019) Min 03 Fa Pei No. 1: 1. Pay Hu RMB 494,130.16 as compensation for personal freedom; 2. Pay Hu RMB 50,000 as moral damages; 3. Reject Hu's other compensation claims. Hu, dissatisfied with the compensation amount, applied to the Compensation Committee of the Fujian High People's Court for a compensation decision.

The Compensation Committee of the Fujian High People's Court found that Hu had been actually imprisoned for 2,202 days based on the original judgment, and the period by which his imprisonment exceeded the six-month sentence determined in the retrial criminal judgment due to the non-establishment of some charges and erroneous factual findings was 2,020 days. On October 26, 2020, it rendered state compensation decision (2020) Min Wei Pei No. 4: 1. Revoke Item 1 of the Putian Intermediate People's Court's state compensation decision (2019) Min 03 Fa Pei No. 1; 2. Affirm Items 2 and 3 of the Putian Intermediate People's Court's state compensation decision (2019) Min 03 Fa Pei No. 1; 3. The Putian Intermediate People's Court of Fujian Province shall pay Hu RMB 700,435 as compensation for personal freedom and RMB 50,000 as moral damages, totaling RMB 750,435.

Reasoning

According to Article 17, Item (3) of the State Compensation Law of the PRC, where a person is acquitted upon retrial in accordance with the trial supervision procedure and the original sentence has already been executed, the victim has the right to obtain state compensation. Article 6 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Compensation Cases (Fa Shi [2015] No. 24, hereinafter referred to as the Criminal Compensation Interpretation) stipulates: "In a case involving joinder of punishment for multiple crimes, if upon retrial some charges are found not established and the period of imprisonment exceeds the sentence determined by the retrial judgment, and a citizen applies for state compensation for the excessive imprisonment, compensation shall be decided to be paid."

In this case, the original judgment found Hu guilty of fraud and robbery and imposed a combined punishment for multiple crimes. Upon retrial, the Putian Intermediate People's Court of Fujian Province revised the sentence, finding Hu guilty only of fraud. With respect to the compensation issue arising from the reversal of the robbery charge in the original judgment, the Putian Intermediate People's Court applied Article 6 of the Criminal Compensation Interpretation to handle it. Meanwhile, although Hu was still found guilty of fraud and sentenced to six months' imprisonment upon retrial, the retrial criminal judgment confirmed that the original judgment's finding that Hu participated in defrauding Zhu of RMB 23,000 was not sustainable and was legally reversed; the fraud part found guilty only involved an amount of RMB 7,500. At this point, because most of the fraud facts found in the original judgment were reversed, the sentencing for the fraud charge also changed. Therefore, when calculating the period of excessive imprisonment, reference may be made to Article 6 of the Criminal Compensation Interpretation to calculate the time that Hu was excessively imprisoned due to the reversal of part of the fraud facts. Thus, the Putian Intermediate People's Court's determination that Hu's excessive imprisonment period was 1,564 days solely because the robbery charge was not established was erroneous and is hereby corrected according to law. In summary, the period by which Hu's imprisonment exceeded the sentence determined in the retrial criminal judgment due to wrongful conviction and erroneous findings of criminal facts should be 2,020 days.

Article 21 of the Criminal Compensation Interpretation stipulates: "'The previous year' as provided in Articles 33 and 34 of the State Compensation Law refers to the year preceding the year when the compensation obligor makes the compensation decision; if the reconsideration authority or the compensation committee of a people's court modifies the original compensation decision, the compensation for personal freedom shall be calculated based on the national average wage of staff and workers in the year preceding the year when the new decision is made." On June 4, 2019, when the Putian Intermediate People's Court of Fujian Province rendered state compensation decision (2019) Min 03 Fa Pei No. 1, the standard for compensation for infringement of citizens' personal freedom published by the Supreme People's Court was RMB 315.94 per day. On October 26, 2020, when the Compensation Committee of the Fujian High People's Court rendered state compensation decision (2020) Min Wei Pei No. 4, that standard had been adjusted to RMB 346.75 per day. According to the aforementioned judicial interpretation, because the original compensation decision incorrectly determined the period of imprisonment, the compensation committee of the people's court, when modifying the original compensation decision, should apply the compensation standard in effect at the time of the new decision. Accordingly, the Putian Intermediate People's Court of Fujian Province shall pay Hu RMB 700,435 as compensation for personal freedom.

Relevant Legal Provisions

Articles 17, 21, 33, and 35 of the State Compensation Law of the PRC; Article 6 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Compensation Cases (Fa Shi [2015] No. 24)
